featured_reviews.name: Nitin A Khandkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Average grocery shop, only slightly better than the local kirana store.

Earlier this used to be a wholesale store. Then they upgraded and remodeled themselves to look somewhat better than before. It's a small congested shop which sells staples like wheat, rice and sugar, FMCG products like bread, biscuits and cupcakes, and frozen products like butter, burger patties etc. They offer some discount on FMCG products.

They once sold me a pack of dates, which turned out to be old, and shockingly had worms in it. Guess what, even the replacement had worms in it! After that I decided to reduce my visits to this shop, and to only buy FMCG products after carefully checking the manufacturing date, if I ever did visit.

featured_reviews.review_text: This store is into selling adulterated goods. Taking advantage of covid situation. Had ordered multiple items from them using Swiggy. These guys should be jailed.
